MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory cards fit my repeated use of removable storage across cameras and other devices; the card-and-reader bundle also supports transferring files, although I already have a reader.",
    "The regular Fire TV Stick feels like a useful addition to my existing TV and DVD player because it would give me streaming options."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart speakers and Alexa plug introduce voice control that I have not shown a need for; my accessory purchases mostly help devices I already use.",
    "The USB-C cable does not match my established Micro USB, Mini USB and 30-pin connections, and the internal SSD assumes a computer upgrade need I do not have.",
    "The 4K streaming stick emphasizes capabilities beyond my listed 720p TV, so those features give me little reason to choose it now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a broader collection of Amazon and Alexa devices.",
    "My purchases of storage, cables and power accessories seem to have been treated as interest in any storage upgrade, charging connector or connected outlet."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: the connector, supported memory capacity and TV capabilities determine whether an accessory is useful to me.",
    "My repeated memory-card and photography-accessory purchases show more concrete needs than a general interest in new electronics.",
    "An accessory should add something useful to my existing setup; another card reader partly duplicates what I already own, and a larger memory card still needs a capacity-support check."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in storage and practical device additions, but stretched that interest into voice assistants and upgrades without a clear current need."
}
